fraud_detection_agent.description: Real-time fraud scoring agent. Provides transaction scoring, velocity checks, and merchant risk lookups. Deployed and maintained by the Risk & Fraud team.

ai_review.summary: Fraud Detection Agent is a well-scoped risk tool providing transaction scoring, velocity analysis, and merchant risk lookups. API key authentication is enforced on all three tool endpoints. PCI scope is confirmed as the agent processes transaction IDs and merchant identifiers linked to card activity.
risk_flags: velocity_check accepts a raw card_id field — ensure callers pass a tokenised card reference, not a real PAN segment
recommendations: Replace card_id parameter in velocity_check with a tokenised card reference to reduce PCI surface
Add rate limiting on tool endpoints to prevent velocity enumeration attacks
Consider adding a sandbox endpoint distinct from production for safer integration testing
ai_review.auth_assessment: API key authentication enforced on all three tool endpoints via FastAPI Depends injection — X-API-Key header required and validated against a stored key.

score_transaction.description: Scores a transaction 0-100 for fraud risk. Returns risk score, recommendation (approve/review/decline), and triggered signals.

velocity_check.description: Checks transaction velocity for a card in a rolling time window. Flags cards exceeding threshold.

merchant_risk_lookup.description: Returns risk tier, chargeback rate, and dispute history for a merchant ID.

pci_data_masking.description: Masks PAN, CVV, and sensitive cardholder data fields in-place. Returns the same structure with sensitive fields replaced by masked equivalents (e.g. 4111-XXXX-XXXX-1111).
